title: PartnershipRewards
description: A partnership plugin that lets players team up with quests, leveling, rewards, private chat, and daily login streaks.
body:
# PartnershipRewards

A feature-rich partnership plugin that lets players team up and grow together through cooperative gameplay mechanics.

## ✨ Features

### 💍 Partnership System
- Request and accept partnerships with other players
- View partnership info, duration, and level progress
- Break up partnerships when needed

### ⚔️ Cooperative Quests
- Daily quests generated automatically for each partnership
- Multiple quest types: mining, crafting, killing mobs, fishing, playing together, and more
- Bonus quests with rare chances and higher XP rewards
- Progress bars and real-time tracking

### 📈 Leveling & XP
- Earn XP by completing quests together
- Level up your partnership to unlock milestone rewards
- Beautiful GUI to track your level, XP progress, and current quest

### 🔥 Daily Login Streaks
- Both partners must log in on the same day to continue the streak
- Streak multiplier increases bonus XP each consecutive day
- Max 7-day streak for massive XP bonuses

### 🎁 Gift System
- Send items to your partner even when they're offline
- Partners can claim pending gifts anytime with `/partner gifts`

### 💬 Private Partner Chat
- Toggle private chat with `/partner chat`
- Messages are only visible to you and your partner
- Admin spy mode for moderation

### 🏠 Partner Home
- Set a shared home location with your partner
- Teleport to it anytime with warmup and cooldown

### 🏆 Milestone Rewards
- Configurable rewards at specific partnership durations
- Execute custom commands and broadcast announcements

## 🌍 Multi-Language Support
Built-in support for **English** and **Indonesian**. Easily add your own language by creating a new file in the `lang/` folder.

## ⚙️ Configuration
- Fully customizable through `config.yml`
- Smart auto-updater: config automatically migrates when updating the plugin
- SQLite (default) or MySQL database support
- PlaceholderAPI integration for scoreboards and chat

## 📋 Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/partner request <player>` | Send a partnership request |
| `/partner accept <player>` | Accept a request |
| `/partner info` | View partnership details |
| `/partner level` | Open the level GUI |
| `/partner quest` | Get or view your current quest |
| `/partner chat [message]` | Toggle or send partner chat |
| `/partner gift` | Send held item to partner |
| `/partner gifts` | Claim pending gifts |
| `/partner home` | Teleport to partner home |
| `/partner sethome` | Set partner home |
| `/partner top` | View top 10 partnerships |
| `/partner breakup` | End your partnership |

## 📦 Requirements
- **Paper** 1.20.1+ (or forks like Purpur)
- **Java 21**
- Optional: [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)
